profile.summary:
QA Automation engineer.
I love working with tools such as QTP, Loadrunner, and now the new Service Test...

I'd like to find a job mix of using off-the-shelf tools like QTP and also developing test tools.

I like the variety of manual, white box testing as well as automation, black box testing.

My favorite is automation though :)

Specialties: out of the box creativity
I'm a do'er :)

positions.title: QA Software Engineer
positions.description:
Develop test automation for .NET applications, WebServices, as well as backend server testing.
Load test .NET client/server applications and websites. Whenever possible using LoadRunner.
Develop test scenarios for FIX applications and automate into build test environments.
Develop C# test applications for Build Verification Tests (BVT's) in addition to Unit tests.
Develop "mock" test applications for completing code test coverage. Create test harnesses.
Develop smoke tests; create test scenarios for developers to recreate defects in code.
Database is MS SQL server 2008; also, develop QTP 10 scripts for .NET and website automation.
Developed unified keyword, data-driven, functional test solutions with Service Test 11, using WSDL XML over SOAP.
Implementing a test-driven development approach to WCF Web services. SDK tests are being developed in .NET C# using Visual Studio 10, with WPF and Blend technology for UI.

positions.title: QA Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed test automation cross platform for Windows, Linux (RedHat, SLES), Solaris and HP-UX
The software was developed using Java/J2EE technologies, C++, C#, and Flex for the UI/Presentation layer.
Databases were PostgreSQL, Oracle 10g and MS SQL server 2005. 
Developed test automation for Flex builder 3.0.  
Developed automation for Java Servlets and WebServices. 
Developed tests using SOAP UI and Python for WebServices automation (WSDL), JMeter for HTTPS Functional and Load testing and Mercury QTP for UI automation. 
Technologies utilized with the platform included, JBI (Java Business Integration), ESB (Enterprise Service Bus), Apache ServiceMix, and Flex using Flexbuilder 3.0.Source repository is Subversion. 
The development environment was Agile/Extreme Programming.

positions.title: QA Engineer
positions.description:
Acted as Senior R&D QA Test Engineer with large product teams, developing testing and QA test case design and development.
Utilized QTP and LoadRunner to develop tests for load/stress testing as well as acceptance testing.

positions.title: QA Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and developed automated test suites using Mercury's LoadRunner and WinRunner automation tools.
Performed Load and Performance testing for the automated tests with thousands of virtual user's performing millions of transactions. Developed Oracle SQL Stored Procedures as part of the automated test suite.
Developed Linux and Solaris system tools to provide process statistics for automated load testing. Supported a transaction-based product of over 1 million lines of code; worked with customers to troubleshoot problems at point of sale.
Debugged difficult customer related problems, worked with customers to resolve and re-create problems with a large database application involving a very intense transaction based solution.

positions.title: Software Developer/QA Engineer
positions.description:
Developed test automation for the HP OpenView family of products.
Possessed strong failure analysis skills, quickly able to diagnose root cause failures and work with customers to resolve these issues.
Consulted with R&D as well as Marketing staff to resolve customer related product issues and maintain a high-level of customer satisfaction.
Possessed strong multi-tasking skills, able to work well with other functions, R&D, Marketing, Support, customers in large team settings.
Creative and solution oriented, develop a solution to any hardware/software problem that will meet customers' needs.
Consulted with customers to insure solutions meet customer needs as well as project, team, and staff cost limitations.
Developed and managed software system testing procedures, software development, and documentation.	
Promoted and secured beta-customer agreements coordinated and managed installation of product directly with customers.
Provided pre-sales and post-sales technical support for key customers.
Designed and developed worldwide advanced training curricula for flagship product, HP OpenView Network Node Manager.
Educated large-scale companies during hands-on site visits.
Five invention patents related to OpenView (Network Management

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Developed software packages for the B1 bomber avionic system.
Contributed to the success of a software productivity project and increased productivity by 10% with measured results.
Acted as a team member of 20 Engineers and worked very effectively with excellent teamwork and individual contributions.
Member of the Technical Staff (MTS).
Developed software in avionics and defense programs including test software.
Developed software for Cruise missile program and B1 Bomber project.
